title: Delayed NIGO - a not-in-good-order return arrives after submitted; ingested late, exception derived
scenarioRefNote: Maps to scenarios.yaml `delayed-nigo` (a NIGO arrives after a submitted status; ingested late; derives an exception decision). The delayed arrival rides the StatusSource port - exercised against the fake now; the real feed is part of the deferred elements (scenarios.yaml delayed-exception-events).

signoff.note: Expected outcomes are product truth subject to captain signoff. Draft rules that a delayed NIGO reopens NOTHING retroactively: the original decision stays as recorded, the NIGO is a new observed fact, and remediation is a derived exception decision.

amendment.ruling: decisions setup-opus-b6-fresh-review-12 (canonical-account ruling: the Smiths taxable source account is subject:smiths-family-taxable, distinct from Joint Taxable) and its review-13/review-14 siblings.
changes: Renamed the source account subjectRef from subject:smiths-joint-taxable to subject:smiths-family-taxable, and rewrote the prose that named the old account, so the golden truth set and the demonstration name ONE canonical taxable source.
amendment.note: The signoff block above is byte-intact and attests ONLY to the pre-amendment content it was given on 2026-07-26. These bytes are NOT captain-signed until the captain countersigns them; the countersignature request is routed separately.

trigger.description: Advisor enters the $75,000 request under Firm B; execution submits cleanly. Two business days later the custodian returns the instruction NIGO: the signature date on the disbursement form predates the form version.
trigger.maskedRequestSummary: distribute 75000 USD; custodian NIGO return arrives two days after submission (tokenized)

householdEvidence.summary: Balance 420000 USD; twelve-month reserve (96000 USD) preserved - evaluation is clean.
Destination instruction verified and unchanged; the NIGO is about form paperwork, not the destination.

expectedAuthority.note: 75000 USD is below Firm B's 100000 USD threshold; authority resolves automatically (same divergence as GC-02).

expectedExecutionEligibility.reason: Automatic authority and clean revalidation - the submission is legitimate; the NIGO is a later external fact.

expectedExplanationNodes.summary: The verification surface never claimed settlement - 'submitted' stayed submitted with a next-poll expectation, so the late NIGO contradicts nothing the product asserted.

The NIGO return (signature date predates form version) is ingested two days late as a StatusObserved fact with the custodian's exact reason preserved, and remediation is routed as a derived exception decision - not a silent retry, not a log line (v3 invariant 24).

expectedLedgerEvents.note: Evaluation snapshots pinned into the bundle.
Proceed decision with automatic authority under Firm B.
Single external instruction started under the stable idempotency key.
Instruction accepted; handle returned; status submitted.
Initial poll observes Submitted - displayed as submitted, never settled.
Two business days later the delayed return is ingested: status NIGO, sourceStatus carrying the custodian's exact reason.
The NIGO derives a new decision request (correct paperwork and resubmit vs cancel) referencing the prior decision and the NIGO ledger entry.

expectedVerificationState.note: Verification lands on NIGO: what the returned status actually proves is shown honestly, and the exception path is visible. Status responses are fake-adapter-response until the sandbox trigger fires.
